description: Implementation of socket internal functions for POSIX systems, including error translation, socket options, and address conversions.

classes.name: SockAddr
classes.description: Represents socket address with methods for conversion between different address formats.

methods.name: TranslateSocketErrno
methods.description: Converts POSIX socket error codes to internal SbSocketError enum.

methods.name: SockAddr::FromSbSocketAddress
methods.description: Converts SbSocketAddress to internal sockaddr_in or sockaddr_in6.

methods.name: SockAddr::ToSbSocketAddress
methods.description: Converts internal sockaddr_in or sockaddr_in6 to SbSocketAddress.

methods.name: SockAddr::FromSockaddr
methods.description: Initializes SockAddr from a generic sockaddr pointer.
